title: SQLite durability for position and exit records

options.name: Keep WAL with synchronous=NORMAL
options.risk: A power loss or OS crash can lose the latest committed rows, including a record of a real position (AUD-DB-021).

options.name: Use synchronous=FULL
options.behavior_impact: Every commit is flushed to disk, so acknowledged writes survive a power loss.
options.risk: Each write is slower. Measure against the buy and exit paths.

options.name: Keep NORMAL and force a flush after critical writes only
options.behavior_impact: Only buys and exit-state writes pay the cost.
options.risk: Any critical write that misses the flush stays exposed.

recommendation: synchronous-full, subject to measuring write latency.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); S2.
behavior_impact: Decides whether recorded positions survive a power cut.
